svg.text: Bend 2.0.32 to 2.0.40 on 15 real ML workloads
Instructions on every release against the first release each workload builds on (0% = as many), each on its own scale.
fewer instructions than the release before (beyond 0.1%)
does not build on that release
softmax and cross-entropy, rows in place
Releases 2.0.32-2.0.40 along each axis. Cachegrind's instruction count, one thread; each workload's releases counted one after
another on one GitHub runner (clang 18.1.3), so a line compares with itself. Lower is faster.
Source: counts.tsv in history/2026-11-07-v2.0.32-v2.0.40 on the data branch (scripts/history_chart.py).
